title: Dinner Lady 50ml Shortfill – Tobacco Range – Smooth Tobacco
description:
Smooth Tobacco by Dinner lady features a mild tobacco flavour that is felt throughout each vape with a hint of sweetness for a distinct flavour.
Smooth Tobacco by Dinner Lady comes in 50ml bottles with 10ml space to add in your nicotine shot, with 70% VG you can use this liquid in any sub-ohm device.
VG/PG:
70% VG, 30% PG
Bottle size:
50ml
Nicotine Levels:
Zero – 0mg/ml
